mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have overcast skies and a temperature of 69 degrees at Verona Community Park. Please note an air quality alert with an index of 52. It is a new moon night, and we have an exciting ISS flyover starting at 9:08 PM, rising in the West over Mount Horeb and traveling toward the Northeast near Home Depot, reaching about halfway up the sky. The overnight low will be 64 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

In city news, the police department reported a residential burglary and weapons offence occurring on September 10 at Hunter's Cove Way. Officers arrived to find a suspect in possession of a handgun, and the individual was taken into custody after sustaining an injury. Additionally, notices have been posted regarding the upcoming November general election and various engineering reports.

We have a busy couple of days ahead. Today, enjoy live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, the Dane County Farmer's Market opens at the Capitol, and Paddy Mac's features live music. Looking ahead, prepare for the Ironman Wisconsin Loop Festival this Saturday, followed by yoga at Insight Wellness on Sunday, and trivia nights at local breweries early next week.

Regarding the weekly report, officers were dispatched on September 10 to the 600 block of Hunter's Cove Way for a burglary in progress. A suspect was located and taken into custody with a recovered handgun. The individual was treated for an injury and faces charges of burglary and reckless endangerment.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Raspberry Cheesecake. The restaurant is currently open, so feel free to stop by before they close at 10:30 PM tonight.
